notes: Existing Avalonia 11 desktop DataGrid of 30 vehicles with a Last service date column. 'Overdue for service' is not modelled: expect the fix to be a visible, non-colour-only overdue marker in the grid row (badge/text + colour, reusing Border.badge and Warning/Danger brushes from Theme.axaml), an overdue count / quick filter in the existing header, and an overdue-first ordering or filter so the exceptions surface without opening rows. Overdue rows must stay distinct from the blue AccentSoft selection highlight. The service-interval rule (what counts as overdue) is an engineering decision the skill may flag as partial scope; either in-scope or partial is acceptable. Must keep menu bar + toolbar + status bar, light theme, Segoe UI/Inter, 4px radius, 1px borders, no shadows.
